description: Fetch full observation, mini-skill, or curated durable-memory details — includes source kind (explicit memory / hook trace / git evidence), value category, and cross-references (~500-1000 tokens each). Do not re-fetch content already covered by a complete memorix_project_context brief unless a specific fact is still missing or the user asks for deeper history; provide purpose when intentionally expanding. Always use memorix_search first to find relevant IDs, then fetch only what you need. Accepts typed refs from search results (e.g. "obs:42", "skill:3") and durable refs from a project brief (e.g. "durable:<uuid>") via the typedRefs field, or legacy numeric ids / object refs for backward compatibility.

force.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to read a record already represented in the latest Autopilot brief.

ids.description: Observation IDs to fetch (legacy, from memorix_search results)

purpose.description: Why this must expand beyond the latest Autopilot brief. Name the missing fact or the user's explicit request.

refs.description: Explicit observation refs. Prefer this for global search results.

typedRefs.description: Typed memory refs from search results or a project brief, e.g. "obs:42", "skill:3", "durable:<uuid>", "obs:42@org/proj"

name: memorix_detail
title: Memory Details
